shapes.html: We define system composition through single-step components.

notes: The left side shows components connected as a network. On the right, the same composition is exposed as one stateful component. In the sequential and parallel cases, the composite retains both state resources; the colours let us follow them. In the pass-through case, the additional signal is simply carried alongside the component. This is a correspondence between descriptions of the system. It does not choose a physical implementation or merge the two state values into one indistinguishable state. The behavioural/compositional correspondence uses the established synchronous lifting; pass-through and parallel forms use the synchronous pairing isomorphism from P9. Do not infer unrestricted interchangeability under arbitrary state sharing, physical timing or implementation mappings. This is not a hardware-sharing or cost-reduction optimization. Transition: Within each composite machine, we can now identify the single-step construction separately from the state carried between reactions.
